"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Colour, Picture, Scene

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 28
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)
SCORE_COLOUR = (240, 240, 240)
MAZE = [  # the maze: "#" is a wall, a space is a path
    "###############",
    "#         #   #",
    "######### # ###",
    "#       # #   #",
    "# # ##### ### #",
    "# # #   # #   #",
    "# # # # # # # #",
    "# # # # # # # #",
    "# ### # # # # #",
    "#     #     # #",
    "###############",
]

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(66, 66, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
walls = scene.add("walls", Colour("darkgray", round=6),
                  grid=MAZE, cell=40, at=(20, 20), hitbox=(40, 40), layer="scenery")
monster = scene.add("monster", Picture("assets/blue_monster.png"),
                    size=(34, 33), at=(143, 263), layer="things")

score = 0
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    player_was = player.topleft  # where it was before it moves
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())
    # Open Nest: walls are solid: walking into them puts the player back.
    if scene.touching(player, "walls"):
        player.topleft = player_was

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: reaching monster scores a point, and the player starts the maze again.
    if scene.touched(player, "monster"):
        score += 1
        player.topleft = (66, 66)
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    screen.blit(font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, SCORE_COLOUR), (10, 10))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Coin, Colour, Picture, Scene

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 28
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)
SCORE_COLOUR = (240, 240, 240)
MAZE = [  # the maze: "#" is a wall, a space is a path
    "###############",
    "# #     #     #",
    "# ##### # # ###",
    "#     #   #   #",
    "##### # ##### #",
    "#     # # #   #",
    "# ##### # # ###",
    "#   #     #   #",
    "### ######### #",
    "#             #",
    "###############",
]

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(66, 66, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
walls = scene.add("walls", Colour((112, 128, 144), round=6),
                  grid=MAZE, cell=40, at=(20, 20), hitbox=(40, 40), layer="scenery")
monster = scene.add("monster", Picture("assets/blue_monster.png"),
                    size=(34, 33), at=(143, 263), layer="things")
coins = scene.add("coins", Coin(), size=(28, 28), at=(146, 266), layer="things")

score = 0
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    player_was = player.topleft  # where it was before it moves
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())
    # Open Nest: walls are solid: walking into them puts the player back.
    if scene.touching(player, "walls"):
        player.topleft = player_was

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: reaching coins scores a point, and the player starts the maze again.
    if scene.touched(player, "coins"):
        score += 1
        player.topleft = (66, 66)
    # Open Nest: reaching monster scores a point, and the player starts the maze again.
    if scene.touched(player, "monster"):
        score += 1
        player.topleft = (66, 66)
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    screen.blit(font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, SCORE_COLOUR), (10, 10))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
